title: Cores of Binary 3-Qualitative Independence Hypergraphs
description: We prove that the binary 3-qualitative independence hypergraph 3-QI(n,2) is a core for every n >= 8, resolving an open problem of Thomas and Akhtar. The main structural result is a balanced-layer lift: if the most balanced layer is a core, then so is the full hypergraph. The package includes the manuscript, verification programs, source files, and review records. The manuscript and prose documentation are licensed CC BY 4.0; the verification code is licensed MIT. The manuscript has not yet undergone independent specialist peer review.
